visual_action: A fast-paced montage portrays Donald Trump in various presidential and campaign-style settings. The video includes shots of Trump walking on the White House lawn, boarding and flying in Marine One, meeting with foreign leaders and dignitaries (including in the Middle East, and with flags of Germany, Italy, and Ukraine visible), and interacting with military personnel. B-roll footage shows law enforcement actions, including border patrol on horseback and ATVs in a desert, a large group of inmates in a prison, and police arresting a suspect. There are also scenes of American workers, cheering crowds at rallies, military graduates, and Trump signing documents and giving speeches. The montage concludes with shots of Trump and Melania Trump watching fireworks over Washington D.C.
